thought: Dusk on Throop Ave, the sky going deep blue with pink clouds, and the street lamps are just coming on. There's a white SUV on my left about five metres off. I'll turn toward it and walk over.
I'm in the SUV. The radio is on WBED 88.9, Brownstone Boom-Bap, and the camera sits right behind the hood. I'll ease off and roll up the avenue.
Out on the avenue now at about 26 km/h. The camera is tight behind the car, and the sky is a deep blue with a pink cloud. I'll open it up and go faster down the avenue.
I'm stuck at 3 km/h. There's a white SUV right in front of me, about five metres ahead, and the car is wedged behind it. I'll steer left round it into the empty lane and keep going.

Something bumped, and a single star just lit up on the HUD, so I've probably clipped the kid on the sidewalk or the red car. I'm squeezed between a red car and the kerb. I'll reverse and steer out the other way.

I'm free of the jam and rolling again, but the star is still lit. The sky is going navy now, the lamps and lit windows are coming on, and the car ahead is still close. I'll pull left round it and push hard down the avenue.
That turn went wrong. I'm now pointing west, stopped, with a red SUV on my right and the shopfront in front of me. I'll reverse out and straighten up.

The camera has swung round so that a green car fills the bottom of the screen, with a headlight glare, and I can barely see ahead. The sky is turning orange at the horizon. I'll roll forward and steer right to face north again.

I'm rolling again at 12 km/h but still facing west. There's a glowing rainbow ring on the road to my right, which looks like a pickup marker for the Bodega Run offer. I'll keep steering right to bring the nose round.
I'm boxed in again, with a sedan right in front of me and the car nose-on to the kerb. Driving here is fiddly. I'll get out and try a different car.
I'm on foot on the pavement. The SUV I just left is right beside me and its headlight is blooming like a lamp. I'll turn toward the sedan parked ahead and to the right and walk to it.
There's an empty sedan just ahead and a little to my right. I'll turn to face it and walk up to the door.
